title: Beethoven and the exposition repeat
question: Opening pauses, the second time
intro: Three short Gs fall on a held E♭, then three Fs on a held D. At Beethoven’s repeat sign the orchestra plays all 124 bars again, including the pauses, the horn call and the quiet violin tune in E♭ major.
listenFor: The held E♭ and D stop the opening on each pass, before the strings start again.

sources.title: Mutopia 941: Beethoven, Symphony No. 5, first movement — Breitkopf and Härtel, 1862–65
LilyPond orchestral sources: every part encloses bars 1–124 in the same two-pass repeat, with no alternative ending
